cases.name: symlinked_source_ancestor
cases.details: The manifest source is a regular file reached through a symlinked directory; direct is_symlink does not detect the ancestor.

cases.name: preseeded_generated_artifact_and_audit
cases.details: The mock builder only prints the success marker. The generated artifact and PASS report were supplied as buildInput and nevertheless counted as newly reproduced.

cases.name: optimized_assert_based_audits
cases.details: An unconditionally failing mock audit assert was skipped under inherited PYTHONOPTIMIZE=1; the wrapper still issued PASS. Artifact generation itself remained deterministic.

scope: Isolated mock fixtures testing wrapper validation only; not a claim about failure of the real mathematical pipeline or the eventual manifests.
